transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, hi Doctor. Thank you for seeing me, I really appreciate it. I, uh... I hope I'm doing this right, coming here. I don't want to be a bother to anyone, really. 

I'm mostly here because... well, everybody keeps acting like I’m just imagining things, and I really don't want you to think badly of me. I'm a reasonable guy, I just do my job at the assembly plant and try to keep the peace. But... it's my wife’s relative. He’s been coming into the house to get at me. 

I know that probably sounds strange, and I hate to even bring it up. Is it okay that I explain? It's just... my tools, you know? I work with my hands, I know exactly where I leave my tools, and they don’t just move themselves. And every single weekend, my fishing plans end up getting spoiled, and it's just not by accident anymore. I've kept quiet about it for months because I didn't want to make a fuss or cause drama for my wife, but... I can see plain as day he’s been trying to take over my place and push me out. 

I hope that makes sense. I'm just trying to handle this the right way, I'm really not trying to be difficult.
Can you tell me more specifically what you believe your wife’s relative is trying to do to you?

Well, doctor... I hope I don't sound foolish saying this out loud. I know it's a lot to take in, and I really hate to speak ill of my wife's family. But... I think he's literally trying to replace me. 

Like, he wants to make me look incompetent so my wife gets fed up and I have to leave. I think that's why he messes with my tools. I've been an assembler for thirty years, I know my tools. But if I can't fix things around the house, or if I look like I'm losing my mind because I can't find my own socket wrench, I look useless to her, right? And ruining my fishing trips... it's like he's trying to break my spirit so I just give up and walk away. 

I really wouldn't say this if I wasn't completely sure. But after watching this happen for months, it's just plain as day that he wants my life, my house... he wants to push me out and take over my place. I'm sorry, I know that sounds awful to say about someone. Am I explaining that okay? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Have you ever felt that there are other people involved in this plan to replace you, or do you believe it's only this relative acting on their own?

Oh, no, no... I really don't think anyone else is involved. I hope I didn't make it sound like that. I'm not... you know, I'm not one of those guys who thinks the whole world is out to get him or anything. I know that would sound pretty crazy, wouldn't it? 

It's really just him. My wife is an absolute angel, she just doesn't see what he's doing, and I'd never, ever accuse her of being part of it. And my buddies at the plant, they're all good people, we all get along fine. So, no, it's strictly just this one relative acting on his own. 

I really try to give people the benefit of the doubt, I do. I don't want to be a burden or make a big deal out of nothing. Does that make sense, Doctor? I just want to be sure I'm giving you the right picture here and not making things seem worse than they are. Am I doing okay?

Have you ever had any other experiences or beliefs, outside of what you've described about your wife's relative, where others might say you're convinced something is happening or being done to you that they don't believe is real?

No, no, nothing like that. I really hope I'm not giving you the wrong impression here. I'm just a regular guy, you know? I go to work, I come home, I try to take care of my house. I've never had any... well, any other issues where people thought I was making things up or anything. 

I know how this all must sound, and I really don't want you to think I'm the type of person who goes around making wild accusations. It's just this one very specific situation with him. Everything else in my life is completely normal, I promise. I don't have any other... strange ideas or anything like that. 

I just want to be honest with you, Doctor. Am I answering your questions alright? I really want to make sure I'm doing this the right way.
Have you ever had any other fixed, false beliefs that others might not share or understand, even if they seemed completely real to you at the time?

Oh, um... no, doctor. Truly, I haven't. 

I know it probably sounds like a broken record, and I hope I'm not being difficult by giving you the same answer again. I really don't want to frustrate you. I know you have to ask all these questions to do your job, and I'm more than happy to answer whatever you need me to. 

But no, there's absolutely nothing else. Just this one terrible situation with him. Everything else in my head is just... normal, everyday stuff, you know? Just work at the plant, taking care of the house, spending time with my wife. I don't have any other... well, I guess you called them false beliefs, or anything like that. 

I really hope that's alright? I'm just trying to be as honest as I can so you have exactly what you need for your notes. Am I still doing okay?

Have you ever had any experiences where you believed something strongly that others didn’t agree with, even when there was no evidence to support it—like thinking someone was sending you secret messages or that you had a special connection to someone famous?

Oh, goodness, no. No secret messages or... or knowing anyone famous. I don't know anybody famous, just the guys on the assembly line and my neighbors. 

I actually feel a little bad keeping on saying no to you, Doctor. I know you're just doing a really thorough job, and I appreciate how careful you're being with me, I really do. It's just... I'm a pretty boring guy, to be honest. I don't have any grand ideas about myself or anything like that. 

I hope I'm not making your job harder by not having more to tell you about these things. I'm really trying to think hard if there's anything even close to what you're asking, just so I can be helpful to you, but... there really isn't. Is that okay? I just want to make sure I'm being a good patient and giving you exactly what you need for your evaluation.
Have you ever had any thoughts or beliefs that you know might sound strange, but you felt deeply and strongly about, even if no one else shared them or believed them?

No, I really haven't. I... I know you're asking about all these different kinds of thoughts, and I really hope I'm not disappointing you by just having the same answer every time. 

I promise I'm really searching my memory for you. I just... I don't have any strange thoughts like that. It's really just this one awful thing with my wife's relative. Besides that, I'm just a regular guy who goes to work at the plant and tries to keep his head down. 

I'm so sorry if I'm not giving you the kind of answers you're looking for. I really want to be helpful. Are we... are we still doing okay? Am I answering these the right way for you?

Have you ever believed something that you know would sound extremely strange or impossible to most people, even to the point where you might not have told others because you knew they wouldn't understand?

No, doctor. Truly, nothing like that at all. 

I... I feel like I'm letting you down, honestly. You've asked me this in so many different ways, and I can tell you're looking for something specific, and I just... I don't have anything else to give you. I really wish I did, just so I could be more helpful to your investigation, or your notes, or whatever you need. 

I don't keep secrets like that, and I don't have any impossible thoughts. I know the thing with him sounds crazy to some people, but it's the truth, and it's the only thing that's wrong right now. Everything else is just... normal. 

I'm really trying my best here, Doctor. I hope you're not getting frustrated with me. Am I... is this still helpful for you? I just want to make sure I'm doing this right.
Have you ever had any thoughts or suspicions that others might consider completely unrealistic or impossible, even when you knew there was no real proof to support them?

No, sir. I really haven't. I... I know you're just being thorough, and I really, really appreciate how much time you're taking with me. It shows you really care about getting this right. 

But I feel terrible that I keep giving you the same answer. I'm really searching my brain here, trying to think if maybe I ever thought something like that, just so I can give you a better answer. But I'm just a regular guy. I go to work, I come home... there's no impossible thoughts or... or anything unrealistic. 

I'm so sorry. I know you're trying to figure this all out, and I really want to be a good patient for you. Are my answers okay? I'm not messing up your evaluation by not having these things, am I? I just want to make sure I'm giving you what you need.
